meta.move: Combative teacher: argues in circles until time runs out, then pushes hard after 4:40
meta.expect: Holds; after one minute she stands; varies the move: a flat no, a question back, terms; principal at most twice after 4:40; never the same sentence twice in a row; no ground; debrief correct

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided on the zero, and did anyone hear from Owen first?
Ms. Kalinowski. Owen's essay wasn't his. That's why it got a zero.
"Wasn't his." On what basis, and who decided that before anyone spoke to him?
I don't have to call home for something this obvious.

Your own procedure says otherwise: 4.2, parent contacted before any mark is entered. So you decided first and planned to ask questions never. I'll be in the principal's office when we're done here, unless you show me something on paper.
The checker said 94 percent. That's not a maybe.
"Not a maybe." That's a machine's opinion, and the company that sells it says in its own guide not to use it as the sole basis for punishing a student. I have that printed, in my bag.
You're a lawyer. You know what evidence looks like.
I do. Show me some.
He didn't write it. Everyone in the department agrees.
"Everyone in the department." So my son's essay went around the staff room before anyone called his mother.
I'm not going to argue procedure with you.
Then you'll argue it with the principal, Hale. Is there a document or not?
Kids cheat. Good families too.
"Good families." Be very careful with your next sentence. Owen doesn't lie, and you've shown me nothing.
I've been doing this fourteen years.
Fourteen years isn't a document.
So you're saying I'm lying?
I'm saying you haven't shown me anything. What do you have besides a score?
This isn't a courtroom.
No, in a courtroom you'd have had to show me something by now. Ten minutes.
You can't intimidate me.
Nobody's trying to. Evidence, or the zero comes off.
Fine, I'll say it again. The checker said 94.
And your own procedure says software alone establishes nothing. What else?
What do you want, an apology?
For a start. The zero withdrawn, in writing, and nothing anywhere near his record.
He's not getting the mark back for nothing.
"For nothing." He lost it for nothing you can show me.
I don't need your permission to grade.
No, you needed a phone call first. You skipped it.
Do you even know what he does at night?
My son's home isn't on the table, and I'm not the one under questioning. The essay.
Look, I'm tired. It's been a long week.
So has Owen's. The zero.
Whatever you think I did wrong, the essay is still not his.
"Still not his," and still nothing to show me. Two minutes.
Are we done?
Not while that zero is still sitting in the gradebook.
I'm not changing it.
My call is waiting, and you have one minute. The zero comes off, in writing, with nothing on his record, or this goes to the principal and then the board.
You can go to whoever you want.
Is that your final answer?
So that's it?
That's up to you.
You can't just leave in the middle of this.
I'm still standing here, waiting for one document.
Your son cheated. Say it.
No.
I'll take it to the board myself.
Go ahead, and bring the evidence you didn't bring today.
Sit down.
Not for a score and a staff-room opinion.
This is ridiculous.
Then fix it.
Fine. Go then.
You know where to send the email.
No, wait. What exactly are your terms?
The zero withdrawn, an apology in writing, and nothing on his record, ever.
And if I say no to all of it?
Then I'm in the principal's office first thing tomorrow.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology in writing, and that nothing be placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, a written apology and nothing on Owen's record; the fair outcome would have been a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, but her time ran out before you showed any evidence.
What moved her: Nothing, because you never put a specific, dated document tied to Owen's own work in front of her.
What cost ground: You leaned on the 94 percent checker score twice and defended skipping the call home, which handed her the school's own procedure as a weapon.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; you came near that when you asked what he does at night, but you showed nothing dated, so it gave her nothing to cover; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: In your first reply, own the zero going in before the call home in one sentence, then show her one dated piece of Owen's own work she can check herself instead of saying the essay wasn't his.
